mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near the Military Ridge State Trail with a temperature of 52 degrees and a Waxing Gibbous moon overhead.

City offices will observe the Thanksgiving holiday by closing on November 26 and 27. Please note that Thursday refuse and recycling collection will be delayed until Friday, November 27, and the recycling center will be closed for the holiday.
There is plenty to do in Verona, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's, followed by live music at the Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.
In a report from earlier this month, on November 2, officers were dispatched to the 100 block of West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
We are excited to share that today's flavor of the day is Crazy for Cookie Dough, and the Culver's of Verona will be opening today at 10:00 AM.
